summary.text: Kevin Raper is a Republican state representative and former educator who has represented Tennessee House of Representatives District 24 since November 8, 2022, and he is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Kevin Raper graduated from McMinn Central High School in 1982.

He earned a bachelor's degree in mathematics education from the University of Tennessee at Knoxville in 1987, a master's degree in education from Tusculum University in 1996, and an education specialist degree from Tennessee Technological University in 1997.
His career experience includes working as an educator.
Raper succeeded Mark Hall in the District 24 seat and served as vice chair of the Education Instruction Committee and a member of the Local Government Committee in the 2023-2024 session.
